strongest_argument: The claim's central premise is contradicted by the company's own primary disclosure. On the Q1 2026 call (2026-05-22) So-Young stated 59 centres across 17 cities as of the call date, a net +10 versus 49/15 at year-end 2025, meaning five centres were added in Q1 and another five between 2026-03-31 and 2026-05-22 - roughly the same run-rate seven weeks into Q2. The network had not stopped growing when it was last actually counted. The 2026-06-23 ichaoqi piece is therefore not an independent recount: it asserts 54 clinics in 16 cities with no source and no as-of date, reproducing the March-31 quarter-end press-release figure verbatim and undercounting the company's own publicly stated position by five stores and one city a full month later. That is an absence of reporting, not evidence of a freeze - exactly the failure mode this hypothesis needed to clear. Separately, to the extent openings are slowing, management published it itself in the same release: 'while maintaining a measured expansion pace'. Finally the sign is not what the claimant assumes: their own mechanism (new clinics unprofitable for 0-12 months) makes fewer openings accretive to the Q2 loss line.

prior_publication.what_it_says: Management states 59 centres across 17 cities as of the call date versus 54 in 16 cities at March 31, directly refuting a post-Q1 store-count freeze.
Company release gives 54 centres in sixteen named cities at 2026-03-31, 41 profitable and 48 cash-flow positive, and says it will expand at a measured pace - publishing the deceleration itself.
Q4 2025 coverage establishing 49 centres in 15 cities at year-end and the announced plan to add at least 35 centres in 2026.
The claim's own source: an unsourced, undated assertion of 54 clinics in 16 cities matching the March-31 release and lagging the company's own 2026-05-22 statement by five stores and one city.

baseline_evidence: The tape points against the claim. SY is +30.43% over 20 days and +4.8% over 5 days into the print at $2.40, a stock being bid into the event rather than one discounting a growth stall, and +81.8% off its 52-week low. Options give no corroboration: put/call open interest 0.11 on 200 total contracts, 40%-of-mid ATM spread, no computable 25-delta skew, so there is no downside protection bid to point to. The last observable print on 2026-05-22 sold off on precisely the revenue-beat/loss-widens-on-expansion configuration the claim invokes.
materiality: immaterial, and partly wrong-signed - roughly five to ten deferred openings against a 59-centre base, where each deferred opening is a deferred cost; against Q2 guidance of RMB 307-317m and a Q1 net loss of RMB 49.2m a handful of unopened clinics does not move the print
what_would_change_my_verdict: A dated, independently sourced count taken after 2026-05-22 showing the network still at 59 or below as of 2026-06-30, together with management withdrawing or cutting the 35-centre 2026 target.
